jobs.title: Retail Training Specialist - Walmart
jobs.description:
A Retail Training Specialist \- Walmart is responsible for delivering training programs to field merchandisers to ensure consistent implementation of merchandising standards, product knowledge, and brand representation across designated territories. This role involves conducting hands\-on training and providing ongoing support to enhance the performance and productivity of field managers. **What’s in it for you?*** A competitive salary with benefits package.
* Be a part of a collaborative and culture\-oriented team.
**What will you do?*** Deliver comprehensive training programs and materials for field merchandisers, including manuals, presentations, and visual aids.
* Travel up to 75 miles within assigned territory.
* Conduct on\-site and virtual training sessions to educate field merchandisers on standards, product features, and promotional campaigns.
* Train field merchandisers on product placement, signage, and display techniques to maximize visual impact and sales.
* Provide hands\-on coaching and feedback during store visits to reinforce training concepts and address performance gaps.
* Collaborate with field managers to identify training needs and prioritize skill development areas.
* Monitor and evaluate training effectiveness through metrics, observations, and feedback.
* Update training materials based on product changes, guidelines, and industry trends.
* Support new product launches and store resets with timely training sessions and resources.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on merchandising best practices, trends, and competitor activities.
* Foster a positive learning environment and culture of continuous improvement among field merchandisers.
* Cover open territories executing client\-specific work.
**How will you succeed?*** Demonstrate strong interpersonal and organizational skills.
* Be a self\-starter, quick learner, detail\-oriented, flexible, and agile in adapting to various tasks and situations.
* Able to effectively communicate with others.
**Experience and Qualifications*** High school diploma/GED required.
* Prior retail experience and/or retail training experience is preferred.
* Proficient in operating a smartphone and apps, sending/receiving emails, sending/receiving text messages, E\-learning platforms.
* Must have a valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and be available for occasional weekend work.
**Work Environment and Physical Requirements*** Have good vision and the ability to stand, walk, sit, stoop, and kneel.
* Be willing and able to work in cold environments conditions.
**So, are you Premium’s next Walmart Retail Training Specialist?**

jobs.title: Health Information Management Specialist
jobs.description:
The Health Information Management (HIM) Specialist is responsible for supporting the integrity, accuracy, confidentiality, availability, and security of patient health information across the Family of Companies. This position serves as a centralized resource for medical record management, release of information requests, record audits, record corrections, document management, regulatory compliance activities, and health information governance.
  

  

The HIM Specialist collaborates with clinical, operational, compliance, quality, legal, and technology teams to support the completeness, defensibility, and compliance of medical records with regulatory requirements, and is readily available to support quality care, audits, accreditation activities, government investigations, payer requests, and business operations.
**Essential Job Functions**

Medical Record Management


* Maintain, organize, and monitor electronic and paper medical records to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance.
* Review medical records for deficiencies, missing documentation, signature requirements, and documentation quality.
* Process record corrections, amendments, and updates in accordance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.
* Support designated record set management and legal medical record maintenance.
* Conduct routine medical record quality reviews and audits.

Release of Information (ROI)


* Process patient, caregiver, provider, attorney, payer, auditor, and regulatory agency requests for records.
* Verify identity, authorization, and legal requirements prior to disclosure.
* Coordinate responses to subpoenas, audits, investigations, and regulatory inquiries.
* Maintain accurate disclosure logs and documentation of record releases.

Compliance and Risk Management


* Ensure compliance with HIPAA, state privacy laws, medical record retention requirements, accreditation standards, and organizational policies.
* Identify and escalate risks related to documentation, privacy, security, or record management practices.
* Participate in internal and external audits and corrective action activities.
* Support regulatory readiness and audit preparedness initiatives.

Data Integrity and Documentation Oversight


* Monitor data quality and documentation standards within electronic medical record systems.
* Assist departments with documentation questions, record requirements, and best practices.
* Identify trends, recurring deficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support implementation of documentation standards and workflows.

Systems and Process Support


* Collaborate with Product Management, clinical teams, and operational teams regarding medical record functionality and improvements.
* Participate in testing, implementation, and optimization of record\-related workflows and technologies.
* Assist with document management, scanning, indexing, and records retention processes.

Education and Customer Service


* Provide guidance to staff regarding medical record requirements, release of information procedures, and privacy standards.
* Respond professionally and timely to internal and external record requests.
* Promote a culture of compliance, confidentiality, and quality documentation throughout the organization.

**Qualifications**

Minimum Education, Experience \& Training Equivalent to:


* High School Diploma/GED required; Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Minimum two (2\) years of experience in health information management, medical records, healthcare compliance, revenue cycle support, or related healthcare operations.
* Experience with electronic health record (EHR/EMR) systems required.
* Experience processing release of information requests preferred.
* Experience supporting audits, accreditation, quality, or payer requirements preferred.
* Certifications (Preferred):
	+ Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT)
	+ Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA)
	+ Certified Healthcare Privacy and Security (CHPS)
	+ Certified Professional in Healthcare Information and Management Systems (CPHIMS)

Additional Requirements:


* Knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security regulations.
* Knowledge of medical record standards, documentation requirements, and health information management principles.
* Understanding of healthcare regulatory and accreditation requirements.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to manage sensitive and confidential information.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and electronic health record systems.
* Ability to analyze records, identify deficiencies, and recommend corrective actions.

Requests:


* Must be able to communicate effectively within the work environment, read, and write using the primary language within the workplace.
* Visual and auditory ability to work with clients, staff, and others in the workplace continuously.
* Frequent speaking and listening (25\-75%) to clients, staff, and others in the workplace.
* Utilize computer and cell phone for effective communication.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities (organized by our company values):**

Community oriented:


* Appreciates and demonstrates collaboration across teams.
* Serves as a role model, bringing our core values to life in your work.
* Work in an exciting, fast paced high energy environment while effectively multitasking and managing day\-to\-day responsibilities without supervision.
* Personable; able to work comfortably with individuals at all levels within the organization.
* Excellent verbal and writing communication skills; frequent proofreading and checking documents for accuracy.

Equity informed:


* Approaches work with a growth mindset, welcome feedback, and understand that humans all have biases and are imperfect as a baseline.
* Sensitivity to working with an ethnically, linguistically, culturally, and economically diverse population.

Bold:


* Navigates ambiguity with an excitement for problem solving.
* Commitment to meet agreed upon deadlines on time or ahead of schedule.
* Transparent on action, pursuits, and outcomes.
* A commitment to the values of the organization while demonstrating good judgment, flexibility, patience and discretion when dealing with confidential and sensitive matters.

Wellbeing driven:


* Willingness and commitment to self\-reflection and re\-thinking.
* Ability to understand your physical, mental, social, and financial wellbeing needs with a willingness to co\-create boundaries that allow you to sustainably show up and honor your humanity.
* Capacity to contribute to and help cultivate effective \+ sustainable wellbeing driven spaces.
* Commitment to managing a remote schedule that aligns with PST business hours, ensuring your availability supports a healthy team rhythm and effective cross\-functional partnership.

**Conditions of Employment**

* Ability to obtain and maintain criminal record clearance through the Department of Justice (DOJ). The People \& Performance Department must analyze DOJ/FBI live scan reports in accordance with applicable Federal, State, and Local laws, as well as fitness for the position.
* Ability to obtain and maintain clearance through the Office of Inspector General.
* Must attend any required training.

**Time Type:**

Full time
**Compensation:**
-----------------

$30\.00 \- $40\.00 Hourly

It should not be considered an all\-inclusive listing of work requirements. Individuals may perform other duties as assigned, including work in other functional areas as deemed fit for the organization.

jobs.title: EMR Analyst II **Optime and Anesthesia** Remote
jobs.description:
**Why work at TidalHealth?**


Looking for a rewarding place to work? Choose TidalHealth, which now includes three hospitals – TidalHealth Peninsula Regional in Salisbury, Maryland; TidalHealth Nanticoke in Seaford, Delaware; and TidalHealth Atlantic in Berlin, Maryland. All three hospitals are “A” rated by Leapfrog Hospital Safety Guide, and the facilities have received numerous other honors.


TidalHealth is regularly adding new practices to grow our offerings in specialty and subspecialty services. These include neurosurgery, cardiothoracic surgery, joint replacement, emergency/trauma care, comprehensive cancer care, wound care, clinical trials and research, and more. TidalHealth is also home to a growing graduate medical education program to prepare the next generation of physician specialists.


Located on the beautiful Delmarva Peninsula, close to the beach, becoming part of Team TidalHealth also offers an ideal opportunity for work\-life balance. Take advantage of our tuition assistance and scholarship programs to grow both personally and professionally.


**EMR Analyst II Position Summary**


The EMR Analyst II provides analytical expertise in the development and implementation of system\-related clinical, access, revenue cycle, decision support and quality improvement applications. He / she will support new project development including system analysis, planning and preparation. Develop, support and maintain documentation and procedures as needed. Provide training to other IT staff and user clients as appropriate. Provides product function, design, and build expertise (obtains EMR module certification) and experience needed for successful product implementation. Supports all project team members with application and information systems knowledge. The Application Analyst is a member of the team of primary resources dedicated to designing, building, testing, and activating the application database. Develops and maintains models and documentation of business and system requirements and configures system accordingly. Documents and maintains all required system design and build documents. Contributes to preparation of testing scripts and materials and performs unit, system, and integrated testing tasks. Works with training team to develop application specific training curriculums and materials. Provides expertise and experience to the development of activation plans, application activation tasks, and production environment readiness. Logs, tracks, and resolves issues as well as any software code modifications or enhancements


**EMR Analyst II Position Requirements**


Required License and/or Certification


* Has EPIC certification in assigned modules


Education


* Bachelor’s degree preferred. Extensive work experience may be considered in lieu of educational requirements on a case\-by\-case basis.


Experience


* 3 years of relevant work experience in healthcare or similar fields.


**EMR Analyst II Work Schedule**


* Day shift, Monday through Friday with call. Overtime may be required.
* Expected to respond in the event of a disaster.


**EMR Analyst II Benefits**


* At TidalHealth, full\-time employees working at least 72 hours per pay period, part\-time employees working at least 36 hours per pay period and part\-time employees working at least 30 hours or more on weekends only are eligible for benefits.
* Benefits include medical, prescription, vision, dental, flexible spending accounts, disability insurance plans, life insurance, paid time off plans, retirement plans, tuition assistance, employee assistance, and access to on\-site childcare and a credit union.

  



  

Location: TidalHealth · Information Services\-TidalHealth Peninsula Regional  

Schedule: Full Time, Monday \- Friday, 8:00\-4:30pm

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Circadia Health**



Circadia Health is a growth\-stage healthcare AI company on a mission to prevent avoidable hospitalizations and transform senior\-care operations. Our Circadia Intelligence Platform combines:


* Contactless sensing that monitors respiration and motion with medical\-grade accuracy
* Native predictive models that detect 85% of preventable adverse events several days in advance
* Enterprise integrations that operationalize predictions directly inside EHR, care\-coordination, billing, and compliance workflows

Today, our technology touches 40,000\+ post\-acute patients daily across skilled\-nursing, home\-health, and home\-care networks. We are backed by leading healthcare and AI investors and headquartered in El Segundo, CA.

**What You'll Do**
------------------


**Implementation and Support**


* Lead on\-site implementation of Circadia's monitoring platform in SNFs, from device installation through go\-live, integrating it into existing care routines rather than adding a parallel process.
* Assess each facility before rollout: shift patterns, unit layout, staffing model, EHR workflow, and connectivity constraints.
* Build and execute the facility implementation plan with clear owners, dates, and dependencies, keeping it current as conditions change.
* Serve as first\-line support after launch: troubleshoot devices and connectivity, resolve staff questions, and escalate product issues with enough detail for Engineering to act.
* Track device uptime and utilization by facility, unit, and shift, and flag gaps before the customer does.


**Training and Adoption**


* Deliver training to clinical and frontline staff across all shifts, including nights and weekends, where adoption gaps usually live.
* Tailor content and delivery to the audience. CNAs, nurses, DONs, unit managers, and facility IT each need a different version.
* Build and maintain training materials and a knowledge base that hold up after you leave the building.
* Identify the behavioral reason adoption is lagging rather than defaulting to another session, and retrain where retraining is the actual fix.
* Develop facility champions and super\-users so competence survives staff turnover.


**Relationship Management and Collaboration**


* Build working trust with facility teams at every level, from the floor to the administrator, so staff surface issues early.
* Coordinate with in\-house care teams and remote clinical providers so the customer experiences one program, not several.
* Participate in interdisciplinary team meetings, contributing implementation insight and ensuring device data is used inside patient care plans.
* Partner with Customer Success, Clinical, Support, and Engineering to unblock deployments, and own customer\-facing communication while a dependency is open.
* Hand off to Customer Success with a documented account state: utilization baseline, stakeholder map, and open risks.


**Quality Improvement and Compliance**


* Feed field evidence to Product and Engineering: failure modes, workflow friction, and what staff actually do with the product.
* Ensure all activity complies with regulatory standards and patient safety guidelines.
* Maintain accurate documentation of implementation activity, staff education, and device functionality checks, aligned to organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Follow facility protocols on HIPAA, infection control, and site access.

**Qualifications**
------------------



**Must\-have**


* Bachelor's degree in business, operations, healthcare administration, nursing, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience in a healthcare setting.
* Comfort operating inside healthcare environments, particularly skilled nursing facilities, with working knowledge of nursing workflows, shift structure, and floor dynamics.
* Clear, confident verbal and written communication with the ability to train and hold a room of clinical staff.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build credibility quickly with audiences ranging from CNAs to facility administrators.
* Practical problem\-solving: you diagnose the cause on site rather than escalating it as\-is.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, managing your own schedule, follow\-up, and commitments across multiple facilities at once.
* Organizational rigor with project tracking tools such as Monday.com. Nothing lives only in your head.
* Willingness to travel up to 75%, including early mornings and occasional overnight shift coverage.


**Preferred**


* Experience implementing healthcare technology, remote patient monitoring, or telehealth services in provider settings.
* Clinical background or license (RN, LPN, RT, CNA) or direct post\-acute operations experience.
* Experience training frontline staff in high\-turnover environments.


As a full\-time **Implementation Specialist,** you will be employed by Circadia Health, Inc. The anticipated annual base salary range for this full\-time position is $75,000 \- $100,000\. The base range is determined by role and level, and placement within the range will depend on a number of job\-related factors, including but not limited to your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.



Annual salary is only one part of an employee's total compensation package at Circadia Health. We also offer:


* Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k)
* Competitive time off with pay policies including vacation, sick days, and company holidays
* Impact: your work will influence care decisions for tens of thousands of seniors every day.
* Culture: hard\-working, mission\-driven, and collaborative — with weekly and monthly social events like yoga, beach bonfires, and Wednesday/Friday team lunches.

Circadia Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: EHR Trainer
jobs.description:
Description:
**MDVIP: Transforming Primary Care, One Patient at a Time**


MDVIP is a national leader in personalized healthcare, empowering over 425,000 members to achieve their health and wellness goals through a network of more than 1,400 concierge primary care physicians. Our program emphasizes preventive medicine, offering comprehensive screenings, advanced diagnostics, and individualized wellness plans. Recognized as a Great Place to Work® since 2018, MDVIP is committed to excellence in patient care and employee satisfaction.

**Role Summary**


The EHR Trainer delivers high\-quality training and education to physicians and practice staff during onboarding, optimization, and ongoing support phases for MDVIP\-affiliated practices using the athenaOne Electronic Health Record (EHR) platform.


This role is responsible for facilitating both onsite and virtual training sessions, ensuring practice teams are confident and competent in EHR use, workflows, and compliance with MDVIP standards. The EHR Trainer partners with Onboarding Managers, Support Analysts, and Revenue Cycle teams to assess readiness, customize training content, and reinforce best practices for documentation, patient engagement, and billing workflows.


Success in this position requires strong presentation skills, clinical workflow knowledge, and the ability to adapt teaching approaches to diverse learning styles and practice environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver onsite and virtual training for physicians and staff on athenaOne EHR workflows, including clinical documentation, scheduling, billing, and communication tools. 40%
* Conduct pre\-training assessments to tailor curriculum to practice needs and experience levels. 15%
* Develop, update, and maintain training materials, quick reference guides, and videos. 10%
* Partner with Onboarding Managers to ensure practices achieve go\-live readiness and user proficiency. 10%
* Provide reinforcement and refresher sessions post\-go\-live to ensure workflow adoption and compliance. 10%
* Document all training sessions, attendance, and follow\-up actions in Salesforce. 10%
* Participate in pilot programs, product testing, and feedback loops with the EHR team and vendors. 5%


This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.

**Key Competencies**

*Performance in this role will be measured by:*


Training Quality and Effectiveness

* Average training evaluation score \= 4\.5 / 5 from participants
* 100% completion of assigned training sessions within scheduled timeframes
* Reduction in post\-go\-live training tickets by \= 10% per quarter


Practice Readiness and Adoption

* All assigned practices achieve go\-live readiness \= 2 weeks prior to target date
* 90\-day adoption metrics for core workflows (AWP, labs, orders, documentation) \= 90% compliance


Documentation and Coordination

* Training materials and checklists maintained and updated with 100% accuracy
* Training attendance, outcomes, and follow\-ups logged within 48 hours in Salesforce/Smartsheet


Professional Collaboration and Contribution

* Active participation in team huddles, knowledge sharing, and curriculum updates
* Minimum two process or content improvement suggestions contributed per quarter


Requirements:
**Required Qualifications:**

* Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare, Education, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
* Minimum 3 years of experience training or supporting EHR systems, preferably athenaOne.
* Strong understanding of primary care clinical workflows, documentation processes, and front/back office operations.
* Experience conducting both in\-person and virtual trainings in healthcare or software environments.
* Exceptional presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications including Excel.

**Why Join MDVIP?**

* Be part of a mission\-driven organization leading innovation in personalized healthcare.
* Drive transformation and growth in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Competitive compensation: attractive base salary complemented by performance\-based incentives for eligible roles.
* Comprehensive benefits: health, dental, vision insurance, and retirement plans.
* Professional development: access to ongoing training and leadership development programs.
* Positive work environment: consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work®, fostering a culture of collaboration and excellence.


MDVIP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected status. We believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and strengthen our company culture.


If you require accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know, and we will be happy to assist.

*Pay Transparency: Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across appropriate US geographic markets. Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and education/training and a candidate's work experience. Hired applicants are offered annual incentive compensation programs, subject to applicable eligibility requirements. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company's performance. The company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements. Medical/prescription drug coverage, Dental coverage, Vision coverage, Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, Basic and Supplemental Life Insurance \& Accidental Death and Dismemberment, Disability Income Protection Plan, Employee Assistance Program, 401(k) retirement program, Vacation, Paid Holidays and Personal time, Paid Sick and Family and Medical Leave time as required by law.*

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist, Heavy Duty Automotive
jobs.description:
**Implementation Specialist, Heavy Duty Automotive**  

**Location:** Remote (U.S.\-based) Preference given to CA, TX, and FL  

**Department:** Customer Success  

**Reports to:** Chief Customer Officer  

**Starting Pay Range: $90k \- $105k/yr**  

  

The Arcadium platform is the premier sales, CRM and vehicle management solution in the heavy\-duty truck market. As part of Work Truck Solutions, Arcadium has a culture that combines strong leadership, collaboration, and fun, with incredible growth opportunities for our employees in a fast\-paced work environment providing employee engagement, recognition, and development. Our software company is committed to innovation in the rapidly changing heavy\-duty vehicle market.  

Our vision and culture allow employees to be recognized as thought leaders and thrive in their careers.  

  

In addition to the job responsibilities and requirements, the following are essential to be a successful member of our team:  

**Curiosity**: you seek knowledge, ask questions, and look for answers; you’re proactive and  

engaged  

**Perseverance**: you hit a delay; you know this is your moment to figure things out and to shine **Innovation**: you want to make things better, solve the puzzle, create something new  

**Flexibility**: there’s a new opportunity; you’re ready to flip the script, grow and adapt  

  

This role owns the successful launch of Arcadium for **newly signed heavy\-duty truck, trailer, equipment, and bus franchise dealers**, as well as the rollout of new functionality for existing customers. Arcadium’s primary product is a market\-specific customer relationship management (CRM) platform built for how heavy\-duty franchise dealers operate. The **Implementation Specialist** is responsible for **on\-time implementation, customer satisfaction, and platform utilization** for each assigned implementation \- assessing each dealership’s needs, configuring the platform to meet them, and training dealership teams on best\-practice use so they see value from day one.  

  

This role sits at the intersection of the customer, the product, and the internal teams that deliver it. The Implementation Specialist coordinates the contributions of Support, Development, Product, Sales, and Account Management to keep every implementation on track, and continuously looks for ways to improve the quality and efficiency of the implementation process, including recommending process and product changes. This is an individual contributor role reporting to Customer Success leadership; it requires strong project management, consultative, and training abilities, and up to 25% travel for on\-site dealer implementations and training.  

**Key** **Responsibilities**
============================

* + **Needs Assessment \& Discovery:** Lead structured needs assessments with dealer principals, general managers, and department leaders to document current workflows, lead and customer management processes, data, integrations, and goals across the dealership’s new and used sales, parts, and service departments.
* + **System Configuration:** Translate assessment findings into a configuration plan and set up the Arcadium platform \- users, roles and permissions, rooftops and departments, workflows, lead sources, templates, data imports, and integrations \- to fit each dealership’s operations and Arcadium best practices.
	+ **Implementation Project Management:** Own each implementation from kickoff through go\-live, building and maintaining the project plan, milestones, and timeline; managing risks and dependencies; and keeping customer stakeholders and internal teams informed of status.
	+ **Training \& Best\-Practice Adoption:** Deliver role\-based training, remotely and on site, to dealership users and leadership, focused on best\-practice use of the platform so teams adopt it quickly and consistently.
	+ **New Functionality for Existing Customers:** Plan and implement new products, features, and expanded use \- such as additional rooftops, departments, or modules \- for existing customers, partnering with Account Managers and Sales to drive adoption and utilization.
	+ **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Coordinate the activities of Support, Development, Product, Sales, and Account Management that contribute to each implementation \- scoping requests, tracking deliverables, escalating blockers, and ensuring a clean handoff to Account Management after go\-live.
	+ **Process \& Product Improvement:** Identify recurring issues, bottlenecks, and gaps in the implementation process and recommend process, tooling, and product changes that improve quality, shorten time\-to\-value, and increase efficiency.
	+ **Field Engagement:** Travel up to 25% to conduct on\-site activities at dealer locations, and participate in company\-sponsored and industry events such as dealer association meetings and trade shows.
	+ **Documentation \& Reporting:** Maintain accurate, real\-time implementation status, configuration records, training completion, and customer feedback within the company CRM system, and contribute to implementation playbooks, templates, and training materials.
	+ **Market Expertise:** Develop deep expertise in the Arcadium platform and our full portfolio of solutions and share information and context internally \- including customer feedback regarding dealership operations and customer needs.


**What Success Looks** **Like**
===============================

* + **On\-Time Implementation:** Implementations and new functionality rollouts delivered on schedule against agreed milestones and go\-live dates.
	+ **Customer Satisfaction:** High satisfaction scores and positive feedback from dealership stakeholders throughout implementation and at go\-live.
* + **Platform Utilization:** Strong user engagement, feature usage, and workflow adoption across implemented dealerships in the weeks and months after go\-live.
	+ **Continuous Improvement:** Process and product recommendations that measurably improve implementation quality and efficiency.


**Requirements**
================

* + 3\+ years of experience in software implementation, onboarding, customer success, or account management within the heavy\-duty technology market, with a history of **delivering implementations on time and driving user adoption**.
	+ Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent implementation projects, balancing timelines, priorities, and stakeholders.
	+ Heavy duty industry experience is required, in one of the following forms:
		- Experience in **sales operations or fixed operations at a heavy\-duty truck or trailer dealership** (e.g., sales management, F\&I, parts or service); **or**
		- Experience **supporting or implementing enterprise\-level software to heavy duty dealers**, such as a CRM, dealer management system (DMS) or inventory or comparable dealership technology.
	+ Familiarity with how dealerships manage leads, customer records, and follow\-up processes, and the ability to translate those processes into software configuration and workflows.
	+ Working knowledge of how a heavy\-duty dealership operates \- unit inventory, spec’ing and configuring customer purchases, parts and service revenue, and the relationship between dealership sales and fixed operations.
	+ Proven track record of conducting needs assessments, identifying operational gaps, configuring software to meet business requirements, and driving software adoption.
	+ Experience delivering effective training to groups and individuals, both remotely and on site.
	+ A continuous\-improvement mindset, with the ability to spot inefficiencies and make practical, well\-supported process and product recommendations.
	+ Strong organizational and project management skills, and the ability to coordinate cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
	+ Strong verbal, presentation, and written communication skills to effectively engage and influence customers both remotely and on site.
	+ Ability to learn a technical product \- including configuration, data imports, and integrations \- and clearly explain its value to non\-technical dealership customers.
	+ Excellent relationship\-building and consultative skills, with a proactive and resourceful approach.
	+ Proficiency in CRM systems, MS Suite or Google Suite, project management tools, and other CRM products. Additionally, the ability to report and present using digital presentation software.
	+ Highly motivated, professional, positive attitude, and thrives in a customer and team\-oriented environment.

**We are proud to** **offer:**
==============================

* + A competitive compensation structure pairing a base salary with an incentive plan tied directly to **On\-Time Implementation**, **Customer Satisfaction**, and **Platform** **Utilization**.
	+ Monday\-Friday work week.
	+ Excellent medical, dental, 401k and complimentary life insurance.
	+ Employee\-paid options on voluntary vision, LTD and FSA coverage.
	+ Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays.
